claim: More than 300 papers will be submitted to the arXiv category astro-ph.EP (Earth and Planetary Astrophysics) during September 2026.
resolution_criterion: YES if the opensearch:totalResults count returned by the arXiv API for search_query `cat:astro-ph.EP` restricted to submittedDate between 2026-09-01 00:00 and 2026-09-30 23:59 is strictly greater than 300. NO otherwise. The count is read by the `arxiv` resolver with no judgement applied. The threshold was chosen against the two preceding months, which saw 315 and 293 submissions respectively, so the outcome is genuinely uncertain rather than near-certain in either direction.
